title: Cartan-Hadamard isoperimetric conjecture
exact_target: Does nonpositive sectional curvature preserve the Euclidean lower bound for perimeter at fixed volume, with equality only for a Euclidean ball?

sources.citation: Mohammad Ghomi, Isoperimetric and total curvature inequalities in Cartan-Hadamard manifolds with nullity, arXiv:2605.24638v1, 2026.
